task: How is the company doing this week?
answer:
The company's operations and support metrics show a significant increase in ticket volume and challenges with delivery performance in the west region this week.

*   Support tickets rose 86% to 54, with 59 tickets currently open and 10 overdue commitments.
*   The overall on-time delivery rate is 85%, while Hub W2 is performing at 77%.
*   "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed a 90% on-time rate; this week it is 77%.
*   "End the west backup courier contract" and "Run the Winter Sale (25% off home) in the west" both assumed Hub W2 could carry the volume; this week the load vs capacity is 157%.

Finance and marketing figures are outside your access.
